correctness.rationale: Every possible palindrome has zero, one or two marked ones, and the proof computes the exact unique/nonunique transition of the centered trims in all three cases. The resulting disjoint cases give all three K values, rational generating functions and limiting law. Two different literal algorithms agree for all 3375 bounded parameter triples and the entire length 5..50 census (17296 triples); these are checks, not infinite certifications.

originality.rationale: Actual published-finding corpus searches, own claim-dedup, and inspected primary published content did not expose the exact global minimal-unique-palindrome list, coefficient formula, or limit law in two-marker words. The closest two-marker MUS theorem concerns ordinary (not palindrome-specific) minimality; the query-specific SUPS ceiling concerns a different count. The relevant Mieno 2026 full article proves maximal-palindrome indexing, not this enumeration. Full 2024 MUPS-related primary content could not be read, leaving a real priority risk.
